label: Chip Chat family answers

params.name: a_tax
params.default: {regime}: tax {tax}{rebate}{surcharge}, cess {cess} - total {total}. This is slab tax on total income after deductions (not salary or special-rate capital gains).
params.label: a tax

params.name: a_fee
params.default: {fee} under 234F if filed after the due date - plus 234A interest.
params.label: a fee

params.name: q_itr_u
params.default: ITR-U: extra tax {amount}, {months} months after the assessment year ended
params.label: q itr u

params.name: a_itr_u_no
params.default: An ITR-U is not possible here.
params.label: a itr u no

params.name: q_refund
params.default: 244A on a refund of {amount} for {months} months
params.label: q refund

params.name: a_refund
params.default: Refund interest: {interest} (half a percent a month).
params.label: a refund

params.name: a_refund_no
params.default: No 244A interest: the refund is under 10% of the tax determined.
params.label: a refund no

params.name: a_kind_on
params.default: That return would be {kind}. Due date {due}; revised or belated by {revise_by}; ITR-U by {updated_by}.
params.label: a kind on

params.name: a_due
params.default: Due {due}. Belated or revised by {revise_by}. Updated return (ITR-U) by {updated_by}.
params.label: a due

params.name: a_advance_no
params.default: No advance tax: a resident aged 60 or more with no business income is exempt (s.207) - so no 234B or 234C.
params.label: a advance no

params.name: a_advance_yes
params.default: Advance tax applies - 234B and 234C follow if it is short or late.
params.label: a advance yes

params.name: a_role_no
params.default: No - a {role} may not: {action}. Someone who may can lend it to them for a client or a year (Delegations).
params.label: a role no

params.name: a_pan
params.default: {pan} is shaped like a valid PAN of {kind}.
params.label: a pan

params.name: a_pan_bad
params.default: {pan} is not a valid PAN: 5 letters, 4 digits, 1 letter.
params.label: a pan bad

params.name: ask_amount
params.default: Which amount? e.g. tax on 12 lakh
params.label: ask amount

params.name: ask_date
params.default: Which date? e.g. if I file on 15/11/2026
params.label: ask date

params.name: ask_months
params.default: How many months after the assessment year ended? e.g. 10 months
params.label: ask months

params.name: ask_age
params.default: What age? e.g. a 65 year old
params.label: ask age

params.name: ask_role
params.default: Which role? firm admin, partner, reviewer, auditor or tax preparer
params.label: ask role

params.name: ask_action
params.default: To do what? e.g. sign off, mark filed, add a client
params.label: ask action
